algorithm: demonstration-assisted TD-MPC2; extension, not original online reproduction

data.shadow_labels: actor supervision only; never replace dynamics actions

pretrain_value_target: discounted finite-horizon recorded behavior returns; not optimal Q
pretrain_losses: upstream weighted latent consistency, reward CE, Q return CE plus supervised actor mean MSE and log-std regularizer
actor_batch: 64 successful-teacher transitions + 64 training-only correction transitions per update
online_replay: 64 initial-data windows + 64 completed-online-episode windows; initial-data only until first online episode completes
normalization: fixed payload training statistics; time stays in [0,1]
checkpoint_selection: report every scheduled checkpoint; no selection by development outcomes
validation_required: fresh documented witness must pass with the identical configuration hash before run; every stage archives sources
scope: single-task development; no independent final-test claim and no automatic extension to 100000 steps
